title: Regularly dream of a dorm and locker room type setting
content: A recurring setting in my dreams is a dormitory-style place with a very large communal bathroom/locker room. This place feels very familiar to me. I am usually alone in the setting and looking for something, often an empty shower stall. The place is mildly run-down but not in complete disrepair. It is usually poorly lit and has a vibe of abandonment. Does this type of setting feel familiar to anyone else? My dream mall has several stories, the predominant colors are black and red, lots of neon—kind of like movie theatre vibes? Usually there is an impressive staircase/escalator/elevator combo. There is a basement area sort of like for employees only: dark, dingy, lots of old stuff stored in storage rooms.
